# AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1 (port)

`engine/render/PrismaShadersExtra.h` (`kFsrEasu`, `kFsrRcas`, `kFsrHelpers`) is a port of the
FP32 EASU and RCAS paths of `ffx_fsr1.h` from
https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR (MIT, see LICENSE.txt) to the PRISMA
GLSL/MSL common subset. No original source file is vendored.
